meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to come back, to return', paired with 'возвращаться'.

examples.trans: I'll be back soon.
He came back home.

examples.text: Так, не шумим. Я скоро вернусь.
examples.trans: Right, no noise. I'll be back soon.

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('evening').

examples.trans: You are saving our evening banquet.

examples.text: Я просто переживаю за вечерний сервис.
examples.trans: I am simply worried about the evening service.

examples.text: Это билеты на хороший вечерний концерт.
examples.trans: These are tickets to a good evening concert.

meanings.note: instrumental of вечер used as an adverb

examples.trans: Come in the evening.
I'm at home in the evening.
Well, come in the evening.

meanings.note: иметь в виду = to mean, to have in mind
иметь в виду = to mean, to have in mind

examples.trans: What do you mean?

meanings.en: on time, at the right moment

examples.trans: Bad timing!

examples.trans: Your timing couldn't be worse! Where are you now?

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.trans: As you all know...

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you

meanings.en: hot (to the touch, of food/drink, not weather)

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'стоящий'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('real, genuine').

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'строй'). Common masculine noun meaning 'attitude, mood, spirit' in everyday Russian.

складываться.gloss: to turn out, develop, take shape

meanings.en: to take shape, turn out, form
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'кладываться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to turn out, develop, take shape', paired with 'сложиться'.

examples.text: Всё складывается даже лучше наших планов.
examples.trans: Everything is turning out even better than our plans.

examples.text: Но часто всё складывается даже лучше.
examples.trans: But often everything turns out even better.

meanings.note: the imperative 'слушай' starts a sentence, like 'look, ...'

examples.trans: Listen, Samson.
Yes, I'm listening.

examples.text: Слушай, Самсон, я тут подумал. Твой начальник — такой опытный специалист.
examples.trans: Listen, Samson, I've been thinking. Your boss is such an experienced specialist.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'остояние'). Verbal action/result neuter noun formed with '-ение'/'-ание'. Common neuter noun meaning 'condition, state' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: Checking the condition of the wall.

examples.text: Эксперты уже начали проверку состояния старой стены.
examples.trans: Experts have already begun checking the condition of the old wall.

meanings.note: с другой стороны = on the other hand
